name: Temazepam
description: Temazepam (Restoril) facts: use for short-term insomnia, dosing basics, risks, interactions, overdose, withdrawal, and how to get it legally.
quick: Temazepam (Restoril) is a benzodiazepine sleeping pill approved for short-term treatment of insomnia, usually 7 to 10 days. It is a Schedule IV controlled substance and shares the dependence and withdrawal risks of other benzodiazepines.
facts: Use with opioids; misuse and addiction; dependence and withdrawal

blocks.p: Temazepam is approved for short-term treatment of insomnia, generally 7 to 10 days. It helps people fall asleep and stay asleep.[[1]]
Cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) is the recommended first treatment for chronic insomnia and works better long term than any sleeping pill.

The figures below come from the FDA-approved label and describe how prescribers typically use temazepam. They are not personal dosing advice. A prescriber sets the dose for each person and adjusts it over time.[[1]]

sections.q: What are the risks and side effects of temazepam?

boxed.title: FDA boxed warnings
items: Taking benzodiazepines with opioids can cause profound sedation, slowed breathing, coma, and death.[[2]]
Benzodiazepines can be misused and can lead to addiction, which raises the risk of overdose and death.[[3]]
Regular use can cause physical dependence. Stopping suddenly or cutting the dose quickly can cause withdrawal reactions, including seizures, that can be life-threatening.[[3]]

blocks.p: **Common side effects** include drowsiness, next-day grogginess, dizziness, headache, and fatigue. Complex sleep behaviors such as sleep-driving can occur.[[1]]

sections.q: What does temazepam overdose look like?

blocks.p: Temazepam overdose causes excessive sleepiness, confusion, poor coordination, slowed breathing, and coma, especially with alcohol or opioids.[[1]]

emergency.title: If someone may have overdosed
items: Call 911 if the person is unresponsive, hard to wake, or breathing slowly.
For advice when the person is awake and stable, call Poison Help at 1-800-222-1222 (US, free, 24 hours).
If opioids could be involved, including pills not from a pharmacy, give naloxone if you have it. Naloxone does not reverse temazepam, but it will not harm the person.
Stay with the person and place them on their side if they are drowsy or vomiting.

sections.q: What is temazepam withdrawal like, and how long does it last?

blocks.p: People who take temazepam regularly, even as prescribed, can become physically dependent within weeks. Rebound insomnia, worse than before treatment, is common for a few nights after stopping.[[3]]

timeline.title: Symptoms begin
timeline.text: Rebound anxiety, insomnia, restlessness, sweating, and tremor.

timeline.title: Acute withdrawal
timeline.text: Panic, irritability, muscle pain, nausea, sensitivity to light and sound, and in severe cases seizures or delirium.

timeline.title: Protracted symptoms in some people
timeline.text: A minority have lingering anxiety, poor sleep, low mood, or tingling that can last weeks to more than 12 months.

blocks.warn: Stopping temazepam abruptly after regular use can cause seizures. The dose should be reduced gradually under the care of a prescriber.

blocks.p: After more than a few weeks of nightly use, the dose should be tapered gradually. Rebound insomnia for a few nights after stopping is common and usually passes.[[4]]

sections.q: How do you get temazepam legally in the US?

blocks.p: In the United States, temazepam is a Schedule IV controlled substance. The only legal way to get it is with a prescription from a clinician registered with the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), filled by a licensed pharmacy. Depending on state law, that can be a physician, nurse practitioner, or physician assistant.[[5]]

ul: **Refills:** a Schedule IV prescription can be refilled up to five times within six months of the date it was written. After that, a new prescription is needed.[[6]]

**Telehealth:** federal flexibilities let DEA-registered clinicians prescribe Schedule II to V medicines after a telemedicine visit, without a prior in-person exam, through December 31, 2026. A permanent DEA rule was under final review in late 2026. State rules can be stricter.[[7]]
**Monitoring:** prescribers and pharmacists in most states check a prescription drug monitoring program, a database of controlled-substance prescriptions, before prescribing or dispensing.

**Pharmacies:** a legitimate pharmacy always requires a valid prescription, has a licensed pharmacist available, and is licensed in the state it ships to. The FDA's BeSafeRx tool and the NABP's safe pharmacy list help confirm a pharmacy is real.[[8]][[9]]

blocks.p: **Traveling:** keep the medicine in its original pharmacy container and carry a copy of the prescription. Check the rules of the destination country before travel, because many countries restrict controlled medicines or require a permit.

Yes, but only with a valid prescription and only from a pharmacy licensed in your state. Many licensed pharmacies, including mail-order pharmacies run by insurers, fill temazepam prescriptions online and ship them. Buying temazepam from a website that does not require a prescription is illegal, and the product is often fake.[[8]][[10]]

A pharmacist verifies the prescription and your identity, then dispenses the medicine in person or by mail.

blocks.p: **Signs that an online seller is illegal:**

ul: It sells temazepam with no prescription, or after only a short online questionnaire.
It takes orders through social media, messaging apps, or email.
It asks for payment in cryptocurrency, gift cards, or money transfers.
It has no US street address, no state pharmacy license, and no pharmacist to speak to.
Its prices are far below those of ordinary pharmacies, or it ships from another country.

blocks.p: The FDA's BeSafeRx tool links to each state's license lookup, and the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy lists verified online pharmacies.[[8]][[9]]

faq: How long can you take temazepam?
It is approved for short-term use, generally 7 to 10 days. Longer use raises the risk of dependence.
Is temazepam a strong sleeping pill?
It is moderately potent. It helps people stay asleep but can cause next-day drowsiness.
Does temazepam show on a drug test?
Yes. Benzodiazepine screens usually detect it for 2 to 5 days.
